test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 29 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Choose the correct one-word substitution for:
"Fear of being enclosed in small or confined spaces."
solution: The correct answer is: **3) Claustrophobia**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Claustrophobia"** refers to the fear of being enclosed in small or confined spaces. (संकीर्ण या बंद स्थानों का डर) • **Example:** Sarah avoids using elevators because of her claustrophobia. • **Explanation:** The term "claustrophobia" is derived from the Latin word "claustrum" (a closed place) and the Greek word "phobos" (fear). It is a type of anxiety disorder where an individual experiences intense fear or panic in confined spaces. (संकीर्ण स्थानों में घबराहट या डर का अनुभव करना) • **Example:** The thought of being trapped in a small, windowless room triggers her claustrophobia. Therefore, the correct answer is: **3) Claustrophobia**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Agoraphobia **(भीड़भाड़ या खुली जगहों का डर): Fear of open or crowded spaces, often associated with a fear of being unable to escape. • **Example:** He avoids going to large gatherings because of his agoraphobia. • **Acrophobia **(ऊंचाई का डर): Fear of heights, which can cause anxiety or dizziness when looking down from a high place. • **Example:** She couldn't climb the mountain because of her acrophobia. • **Xenophobia **(विदेशियों का डर या नफरत): Fear or hatred of strangers or foreigners, often rooted in prejudice. • **Example:** His xenophobia made it difficult for him to accept people from different cultures. da:T1200, सही उत्तर है: **3) क्लॉस्ट्रोफोबिया**।
